job.text: . It was a frame building, four stories high and nicely situated. The proprietors of it intended it should be a family hotel, but it did not meet with the success anticipated, and when, on the 19th of May, 1878, it was burned to the ground it was unoccupied. The fire was thought to be the work of incendiaries. The loss was about $20,000, partially insured. Four firemen were quite seriously injured at this fire, but all recovered. The Carpenter house, on the corner of Summit avenue and Ramsey street, was built by Warren Carpenter

Return one JSON object only with keys entities and relations. entities is a list of {id, name, type, evidence}. relations is a list of {source, predicate, target, evidence}; source and target must refer to entity ids. Each evidence must be a verbatim substring of the passage that supports the item. Every entity MUST include an evidence field, even if the evidence is just its exact name as written in the passage. Every relation MUST include an evidence field. Before returning, verify all entities have all four required keys: id, name, type, evidence. Omit unsupported items. Use empty lists when appropriate. Return compact JSON without indentation. Do not repeat entities or relations. Do not create generic category nodes such as hotel or person merely to express an entity type. A relation must connect two independently identified entities and its evidence must support that specific pair.
